savesHint: Only the Owner can save or replace the shared world. Unsupported files are rejected; empty slots cannot be loaded.
leaseHint: Take control before driving. Release is available only for your own lease.
toolbarHelp: Toolbars: use arrow keys, Home and End to move; Enter or Space activates. Tab moves to the next group.
dirtyHint: Apply this name before continuing, discard the draft, or keep editing.
draftConflict: This station changed. Reset the draft to review its current name before applying.
draftInterrupted: The session changed. The unfinished station draft was discarded.
sharedReplacement: This replaces the shared world for every participant, clears control and construction drafts, and starts paused. It cannot be undone here.
observerHint: Observers can inspect and change local view settings. Game changes require Owner or Operator access; saves require Owner.
waitForSync: Waiting for a synchronized world and map images.
recoveryHint: The game is unavailable until synchronization completes.
authenticationRequired: Authentication is required again. Enter your access key to join.
closePanelToTarget: Close panel to choose a target
unvalidatedPreview: Preview only. Placement and cost are checked on Confirm.
geometryFailed: Target could not be checked. Select it again to retry.
unavailableObject: This object is no longer available.
leaveFailed: Leaving could not be confirmed. Retry Leave game to sign out.
localAccessHint: Leave the key blank to join locally as Owner.
leaseRequired: Train control expired or changed. Take control again.
loadHint: Select a file to check compatibility. Unsupported data leaves the current game unchanged.
replaceWorld: Replace the current game with this save?
incompatibleSave: This save format is not supported. Prototype saves cannot be loaded. The current game was preserved.
referenceWorldHint: Explore the eight-direction rail loop and run, pause or step the calendar. Economy, trains and construction are not available yet.
operationUnavailable: This operation is not available in this world.
savingUnavailable: Saving is unavailable for this reference world.
invalidSave: Invalid save data. The current game was preserved.
saveFailed: Save operation could not be confirmed. Check the connection and server storage.
soundFailed: Sound could not play. Try enabling it again.
toolShortcuts: Tools (with the map focused): I — Inspect; T — Lay tracks; B — Bridge; S — Slope; V — Girder viaduct; U — Tunnel; G — Terrain; R — Remove tracks. Escape cancels the current preview, then returns to Inspect; it also closes an open panel or menu. Construction tools require permission to edit. · L Speed limits
mapHelp: Focus the map for keyboard controls. Press Space to run or pause game time; press N to advance a single step while paused. Click an object to inspect. In Inspect, drag to pan; in every tool, use two-finger trackpad scrolling or middle-button drag to pan. Scroll the mouse wheel, pinch the trackpad, press + / − (or = / -), or use the zoom buttons to zoom. Each zoom key press changes zoom by 25 percentage points (50%–400%). The wheel and pinch zoom around the pointer. Reset camera sets zoom to 150% around the current viewport centre.
constructionHelp: Select a tile, then confirm. Tools keep shared time running; use Pause when needed. 100 per changed tile; buffer extension costs 200. Removal has no refund.
assetsFailed: Map images could not load. Reload to retry.
pickTile: Select a tile on the map
pickObject: Select a map object to inspect
manualHelp: Manual: focus the map. Shift passes; Up departs; Down reverses; Left / Right choose a junction. Run advances time. Escape cancels.
visualSample: Visual sample by the pier: water, fence and slope. Winter ground and recoloring are local display options.
title: FreeTrain Online
subtitle: Web prototype
networkNotice: Inspect the world, operate the train and extend the siding. Changes are confirmed by the game service.
incompatible: Client and server versions differ. Reload after updating.
operatorSecret: Enter access key to join game
accessFailed: Access failed. Check the key and try again.
unresolved: A command outcome is unresolved. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
staleEpoch: The world was replaced. Reconnect and review the current game.
notAuthorized: Operator access is unavailable. Reconnect to sign in.
queueFull: The server is busy. Review state before trying again.
retryWindowFull: Command history is full. Wait before sending more commands.
requestConflict: This request ID was already used for a different command.
invalidInput: The command was rejected. Your draft is retained.
staleRevision: The item changed. Review the confirmed state and retry.
unavailable: Connection unavailable. Reconnect and review state.
catalogHint: Imported building families · select a height to inspect.
terrainWorldHint: Inspect or modify terrain, or use Track and Slope to preview and build railway.
emptyWorldHelp: Create flat ground at the global water level, with no rails or decorations. Defaults store 30 × 42 × 6 cells (the source dialog displays 30 × 30 × 6). Custom H/V: 1–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells; Z: 1–64; water: 0–Z−1. Preview does not pause shared time; any world change invalidates it.
creationFailed: World creation failed or its outcome is unknown. Check the current world before making a new preview.
staleCandidate: This preview is out of date. Preview again.
creationBusy: Another world preview is active. Cancel it or retry after it expires.
heightmapHelp: Import an opaque, single-frame PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF (up to 8 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 4 million pixels). Stored H/V: 1–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells. Brightness sets height; steep steps are lowered and slopes smoothed. Water uses one global level.
heightmapTerrainPreview: Resulting terrain heights and global water
imageFormat: Unsupported image or mismatched file type. Choose PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF.
imageBytes: Choose an image between 1 byte and 8 MiB.
imagePixels: The image exceeds 4096 pixels per side or 4,194,304 total pixels.
imageAlpha: Transparent pixels are unsupported. Choose an opaque image.
imageAnimation: Animated images are unsupported. Choose a single-frame image.
imageInvalid: The image is damaged or cannot be decoded. Choose another image.
generatedHelp: Generate reproducible plains, hills or mountains from a signed integer seed. Relief sets height variation; feature scale sets the wavelength in cells; smoothness reduces fine detail. Stored H/V: 16–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells; Z: 8–64; water: 1–Z−4. Preview never changes the shared world; confirmation uses the exact previewed terrain.
coastHelp: Inland has no coastal sea. An island has sea around its entire boundary. Selected directions use the world compass, keeping other boundary sectors dry. Target sea coverage is measured before lakes and rivers (±5 percentage points). Channels may divide the landmass. Small maps or extreme settings may be impossible.
coastCompass: Overview compass: North ↖ · East ↗ · South ↘ · West ↙ (stored H/V view).
coastMetrics: Surface water: {water}% · Dry cells: {land} · Open water components: {seas}
coastCoverageImpossible: Sea coverage cannot be met on this map. Change coverage or use a larger map, then preview again.
coastTopologyImpossible: A connected landmass and coastal seas cannot be formed with these settings. Change coverage, seed or map size, then preview again.
coastBoundaryImpossible: The requested coast boundary cannot be formed. Increase map size or change coverage or coast directions, then preview again.
waterFeaturesHelp: Lakes and rivers share the global water level. A river crosses the map in the selected compass direction and joins any sea along that axis. Lakes and rivers merge wherever they overlap; isolated lakes keep a dry rim. Lake area is approximate (±1 percentage point or 25% of its target, whichever is larger). Decorative creeks are separate.
waterSettingsInvalid: Check feature ranges and available space.
lakeImpossible: The lake area or separating dry rim cannot be formed. Reduce lake count or area, enlarge the map, or change seed.
riverImpossible: The river or its banks cannot be formed. Reduce width, enlarge the map, or change seed or direction.
forestUnavailable: Select at least one available tree species.
forestHelp: Coverage selects a percentage of dry, reusable cells outside the starting area. Higher clustering makes larger groves. Each cell uses the species’ original scatter density; some selected cells naturally have no trees. Starting area reserves existing level land and does not reshape terrain. Other foliage is unavailable until its installed recipes are reviewed.
forestMetrics: Eligible: {eligible} · Selected: {mask} · Forest cells: {forests} · Trees: {trees} · Reserved: {reserved} · Largest level patch before forests: {flat}
forestLegend: Overview: dark green = realized forest treatments · gold = reserved starting area.
startingAreaImpossible: A connected level starting area of this size cannot be found. Reduce its size or change terrain, seed or map size.
generationCancelled: Preview cancelled. The shared world is unchanged.
worldTopDownPreview: North-up terrain overview of the retained candidate
worldIsometricPreview: Isometric terrain overview of the retained candidate
worldPreviewSampling: Terrain overview: one sample per {step} stored cells on each axis. Blue: water; dark green: forest; gold: reserved starting area. Metrics cover the entire map.
realizedCoverage: Realized water: {water}% · Forest cells: {forest}% · Ground height: {min}–{max}
realizedBuildable: Clear flat dry cells: {flat} · Largest connected level area: {connected}
buildableHelp: Clear areas exclude forest treatments and other decorations, and connect through world-cell faces at the same height. Tool legality, ownership and costs are checked when you build.
cornerAdjustBlocked: This intersection cannot change further in this direction.
cornerLegal: Corner change is legal. Review the affected cells, then confirm.
cornerUnmatched: The touching corners have different heights.
cornerFloor: The world floor cannot be lowered.
cornerRoof: This corner would exceed the world height.
cornerStale: Terrain changed. Preview again before confirming.
cornerCapacity: This change exceeds a terrain or identity limit.
rectanglePickEnd: Pick the opposite endpoint at the anchor level.
rectangleInvalid: Use integer coordinates inside the map, with at most 64 cells in the inclusive rectangle.
repairInconsistent: Neighbor corner heights disagree; this cell cannot be repaired.
repairUnrepresentable: The matching height is outside this cell’s quarter-height range.
rectangleHelp: Pick two endpoints or enter coordinates. Endpoints are normalized at the first Z. Raise/Excavate visit shared corners before the far edges; Repair includes both endpoints. At most 64 selected cells. Ctrl on the second pick chooses Repair; Shift selects the half-height upper profile. Review changes, losses and skipped sites, then Confirm once. A failed cell is skipped; valid sites publish together.
terraceHelp: Place a terrace directly on bare ground or a slope; no corner stroke is needed. Remove it to restore its saved corners, or make and restore a cut. Changes remove forest decoration and ownership. Select a tile or enter its voxel coordinates, preview, then confirm. Water does not restrict these tools.
terraceRequired: Select a terrace voxel below its raised ground.
higherNeighbor: A neighboring ground level is higher than this slope.
authoringHelp: The Owner controls this saved world mode. Everyone keeps their existing permissions. Terrain rules and shared time still apply.
authoringEnterReview: Enable authoring for this world? This clears all participants’ terrain previews without pausing shared time.
authoringExitReview: Disable authoring for this world? Terrain previews will be cleared. Authored scenery is kept.
authoringDecorationsHelp: Select two map points or enter coordinates. Forest: up to 64 cells. Creek: up to 64 route cells at one height; blocked cells are skipped without rerouting. These initialize unowned scenery at zero cost. Trees may grow on underwater ground. A zero-tree result leaves that cell unchanged. Creeks do not change water or ground levels.
authoringInvalid: Use whole-number coordinates at one ground height. Select at most 64 forest cells or 64 creek route cells, and choose an available tree treatment.
authoringLegal: Scenery changes are ready. Review changed and skipped cells, then confirm.
terraceBatchHelp: Select two map corners or enter start and end coordinates, including both endpoints (up to 64 cells). Bare ground and existing slopes at the selected height become terraces, without a corner stroke first. Occupied or otherwise ineligible cells are skipped. Review the highlighted cells and forest/ownership loss, then confirm once.
terraceBatchInvalid: Use integer coordinates inside the map at one height, with at most 64 cells in the inclusive rectangle.
terraceBatchReady: Terraces are ready to place. Review changed and skipped cells, then confirm.
terrainPaintHelp: Click an intersection between four tiles to select it, then click or hold Raise corner / Lower corner. Hold the left mouse button on the map to paint; drag to move between intersections. Each step adjusts the shared vertex by a quarter level. Shift reverses map painting. Changes apply immediately and can remove forests or ownership. Release or press Escape to stop; completed changes remain. Coordinates below offer a preview-and-confirm alternative.
paintReady: Hold and drag on the map to paint.
paintBlocked: This point cannot change further. Move the brush.
paintFailed: Painting stopped. Check the connection or terrain, then start a new stroke.
mixedWorldHint: Build, remove and inspect railway infrastructure. Terrain tools protect occupied cells and preserve tunnel and terrace backups.
railNodeHelp: Move the pointer to preview. Shift-click adds a node (up to 10), or removes an existing intermediate node. Click without Shift to place the complete route; click or Shift-click the start to close and build a loop.
railHelp: Pick A, then B on the map, or enter X/Y coordinates. The start level is detected automatically. Enter a level to override it, then preview, review and confirm.
railHeuristicHelp: Compares the two shortest eight-direction paths between your exact points. Prefers a legal path, then the lower cost; ties use diagonal first. It does not search longer detours. The start needs existing rail or ground at or above the construction level.
railRemovalHelp: Removal uses diagonal first unless you explicitly select straight first. Every visited pier below the selected level is removed, regardless of its owner. Some protected or special rails remain and may still be charged. Review the full loss list.
railCutHelp: Auto detects the ground or existing rail at A within the height cut; B stays at that level. Enter a level for manual plane picking, including elevated or underground track. Change the height cut in View to inspect buried track. Preview and cancel never change shared time. Middle-button drag pans the map.
railLegal: This route is legal. Review and confirm.
railPreviewRequestRejected: The server could not read this route request. If the game was updated, restart the server and refresh the page.
railStale: The world changed. Preview the route again.
railProtected: Rails occupied by cars are preserved; piers below visited cells are still removed.
railNoncoplanar: Both points must use the same level.
railStart: Start on existing rail or at or below the local ground level.
railUnderwater: The route crosses water at this level. Raise the level or choose another route.
railObstacle: An occupied terrain or structure cell blocks this route.
railMiddle: Existing rail may only be at the two endpoints. Split this route at the existing rail.
railAttach: The endpoint cannot attach in this direction. Choose a compatible angle.
railPattern: This operation cannot produce a valid railway pattern.
railBinding: A required railway definition or handler is unavailable.
railPlatform: A platform depends on this rail. Platform removal is not available yet.
railVoxelCapacity: The railway limit (8,192 occupied cells, including supports) has been reached. Remove railway objects to free space, or shorten this route. No changes were made.
railJournalCapacity: The construction history is full (8,192 entries). This change was not applied. You can save this world, but further construction needs a new world. Saving and reopening does not reset the history.
railOverflow: The construction quote exceeds supported numeric limits.
railLevelWaiting: The first map point or start coordinates set the level. The end keeps that height.
slopeHelp: Pick a base on the map or enter X/Y and a level. The track climbs one level over four positions in the selected direction. Preview, review and confirm.
slopePick: Pick the lower end to build, or any ramp cell to remove.
slopeRemovalHelp: Remove selects the entire ramp, including invisible fillers and supports. A map pick detects its direction; keyboard coordinates must match the uphill direction. Normal Track removal does not remove ramps. All piers below the base are removed, including other owners’ piers; review every listed loss.
slopeGhostHelp: Solid outlines show rail cells; dashed outlines show paired fillers or supports. Dotted outlines show new piers; crosses show pier losses. All eight cells remain occupied even where artwork is invisible. Use a height cut to inspect buried tracks.
slopeNotFound: There is no ramp at the selected cell.
slopeMismatch: The uphill direction must match the selected ramp.
terrainUnavailable: Terrain editing is not available in this world.
tunnelHelp: Pick each end on the sloping mountainside or one cell just outside or inside it. The preview finds nearby portals on a cardinal route. Automatic level can adjust by one level; set Track level manually to keep a fixed height. Review the resolved path and cost before confirming.
tunnelRules: Build at or above water level through at least one actual Mountain cell. Empty cells become ordinary railway; compatible existing rails remain. Each new cell costs 12,000,000. No piers are created. Mountain corners are saved, but trees and ownership on replaced mountains are lost.
tunnelRemovalHelp: Removal restores matching, unoccupied tunnel cells from the start up to, but excluding, the destination. The destination and ordinary gap rails stay. Each restored cell costs 4,000,000. Mountains return with saved corners, without trees or ownership. Reverse the route or extend it one cell to remove the retained endpoint.
tunnelMountainRequired: The route must pass through at least one actual Mountain cell.
tunnelComponentDependency: Remove attached infrastructure before restoring this mountain.
girderHelp: Pick two map points or enter coordinates, then preview the route. Auto uses an existing elevated rail or one level above the starting ground, so you can add slopes and connections later. Changing the height refreshes an existing preview. The end snaps to one of eight straight directions. Review the cost before confirming.
girderRules: Every cell must be strictly above its local ground. Existing rails must have both ports along the span and remain unchanged, including compatible junctions. New rails use one of four girder orientations and default piers at every new cell; blocked supports are omitted. Snapping uses the source integer half-distance thresholds and diagonal X length. Both endpoints and unchanged cells are charged; a submerged starting column makes the entire booking zero.
girderRemovalHelp: Remove only matching girder rails along the selected direction without a train car. Both endpoints and skipped cells are charged. Every pier below a removed rail is lost regardless of owner; other rails and occupied skips retain their piers.
girderAboveGround: Every girder cell must be above its local ground. Choose a higher level.
bridgeHelp: Choose two points and a level. The end snaps to a horizontal or vertical line. Review the actual cost before confirming.
bridgeRemovalHelp: Bridge removal visits both endpoints and charges every cell, including other rails and occupied skips. Only matching bridge rails without a train car are removed. All piers below each removed rail are lost regardless of owner; other rails and occupied bridge cells retain their piers.
bridgeRules: Choose two points and a level. The end snaps to the longer cardinal axis (X on ties). Existing rails must have both ports along the span and remain unchanged. New runs use begin/middle/end artwork and alternating bridge piers. Dry land is allowed; blocked supports are omitted. The preview shows the actual booking for every cell, including existing rails.
removeHelp: Select an object on the map or enter its voxel coordinates, review the highlighted cells, then confirm removal.
removeReady: Ready to remove the highlighted objects and their affected supports.
removeTerrainHelp: Ground and slopes in the landscape are shaped with Modify terrain. Select a railway, pier, forest, creek or terrace to remove it.
removeUnavailable: Use the dedicated tunnel or railway-accessory tool to remove this object.
removeStale: The world changed. Select the object again to review removal.
removeLineHelp: Pick A, then B, or enter two coordinates at one height. The stepped line stays as straight as possible. Rails and bridges along it are removed, including across gaps; scenery stays. Whole railway slopes and affected supports are included. Protected objects are skipped and listed.
removeNoRailway: No railway tracks or bridges lie on this line at the selected height.
removeNothing: All railway objects on this line are protected. Review the skipped objects.
garageHelp: Choose two points at ground level. The route aligns to the nearest map axis. Existing tracks must connect in both directions along that axis.
garageRules: Every cell, including existing compatible tracks, becomes garage rail and costs 6,500,000. Garages have no maintenance, fueling or repair mechanics.
garageRemovalHelp: Removal converts matching garages to normal track, excluding the destination. Car-occupied garages stay. Each visited cell charges the running subtotal of 200,000 per matching garage, including protected cars; gaps repeat that subtotal. Reverse the endpoints to include the remaining end.
garageGroundRequired: Every garage cell must be at its local ground level.
garageDependency: A terrain backup or railway slope must be removed with its own tool first.
signalDescription: Place railway signals facing one of four map directions.
signalHelp: Choose a signal from the building catalog, then pick a point on the map or enter Start X / Y. Empty traffic and ordinary track, including curves, can become straight signal track.
signalRules: Signals cost nothing. Junctions, special tracks and obstacles reject placement. Cars protect both placement and removal. Train waits and controller editing are planned for the train phase.
signalRemovalHelp: Remove a signal at the selected point to restore normal track with the same pattern.
signalNotFound: There is no signal at this point.
signalTarget: Only empty traffic or ordinary track can receive a signal.
poleHelp: Choose a point on cardinal straight track. The track sets the pole orientation, including on compatible special rail.
poleRules: Placement and removal cost nothing. Placement replaces the current accessory, even when a car is present. Poles do not simulate electrification.
poleRemovalHelp: Remove any pole at the selected point, keeping track, road and cars. A pole left after track removal can also be removed.
poleNotFound: There is no electric pole at this point.
poleTarget: Poles require straight north/south or east/west track.
stationaryDescription: Decorative piers and signal boxes on the ground.
stationaryHelp: Choose an accessory from the building catalog and a ground point, then preview and confirm placement. Orientation is built into each variant.
stationaryRules: Confirmation starts a construction site. Work advances on weekdays from 09:00 through 17:59 while shared time runs. The full height stays occupied. The completion price is charged to Railway service only when work finishes. These decorative piers do not support track, and signal boxes do not control trains.
stationaryRemovalHelp: Remove selects the actual accessory, including its upper cells, regardless of the selected variant. Completed demolition costs 500,000 per ground cell under Subsidiaries. Cancelling a construction site costs zero and cancels its remaining work.
stationaryNotFound: Choose an accessory or its construction site.
stationaryGround: The full footprint must be on equal ground.
catalogNoResults: No matching objects. Try another search.
catalogBuildHelp: Choose an object to open its building tool. Placement is confirmed on the map.
speedDescription: Set speed-limit sections without changing the track or shared time.
speedHelp: Choose a level range using two map points or XY coordinates. For slopes, choose the lower base and climb direction; four traffic positions are selected.
speedRules: Each selected cell must contain traffic (rail, road or an accessory). Sections cannot overlap any existing limit. Changes cost zero. Train scheduling is delivered with train gameplay.
speedRemovalHelp: Remove clears one entry at each selected location in every speed list. Slope removal accepts any member of the owning slope, with its actual climb direction. Limits disappear automatically when the traffic cell is removed.
speedLimitTraffic: Every selected position must contain rail, road or a rail accessory.
speedLimitOverlap: This section overlaps an existing speed limit. Remove it before adding another.
speedMembershipHint: Select a section to inspect its current limits.
stockEmpty: No trains owned. Purchase stock to add trains.
stockUnavailable: Rolling stock is unavailable for this world or selected pack.
stockNoResults: No rolling stock matches these filters.
stockQuoteFailed: Quote unavailable. Check the formation, quantity and fleet limits, then retry.
stockStale: This quote is out of date. Cancel and request a new quote.
stockRenameConflict: This train changed while you were editing. Reset the name and retry.
stockLimits: Up to 128 trains / 1,024 cars owned. Quotes include every selected train.
stockQuoteHelp: Confirmation applies this exact quote once. Shared time or world changes require a new quote.
stockCapacityScope: Capacities below are totals for the selected quantity.
stockDirtyHint: Save or discard this train name before continuing.
stockFareHelp: Fare uses the source formula: base fare × passengers × truncated 3D distance × 2.
deploymentPicking: Select a rail on the map. Coordinates can also be entered below.
deploymentHelp: Placement starts at the selected tail and follows the track at one height. Reverse changes the facing and car order on the same footprint. Pause time before confirming a preview.
deploymentWithdrawHelp: Withdrawal keeps owned stock and clears its track occupancy and movement timer. It produces no sale revenue.
deploymentFailed: Deployment preview failed. Check the target and try again.
deploymentController: Manual driving uses a separate control lease for each train. Timetable junction and signal actions are not available yet; reaching one pauses shared time.
deploymentMissingRail: The complete formation needs track at the selected height.
deploymentDuplicate: The formation would visit the same track cell twice.
deploymentHeading: The track cannot guide this placement heading.
deploymentOutside: The formation extends beyond the stored map.
deploymentUnbound: This junction needs a controller that is not implemented yet.
deploymentState: The selected train changed. Select it again.
deploymentControllerUnavailable: This train’s junction and signal actions are currently unavailable with its effective controller.
fleetMissingTrack: No connected track ahead after the reversal retry.
fleetOccupiedTrack: The connected track ahead is occupied. The train keeps its direction.
fleetRetry: Movement will be checked at the next scheduled callback.
fleetRecoveryHelp: Run or Step retries automatically. Clear the obstruction, connect the track, reverse the train or withdraw it. Blocked attempts do not incur running costs.
fleetReverseHelp: Reverse changes car order and facing on the current footprint, keeping car identities and the scheduled movement time. It does not move the train or charge running costs. Pause time before confirming.
fleetOccupiedReturn: The first connected return track is occupied. The train waits for that track.
fleetMissingReturn: No connected return track is available.
manualFleetHelp: Take control, then choose Manual. Hold a button or focus the map and hold its key. Shift passes on arrival; otherwise stop for five game minutes. After stopping, Up departs before Down reverses; release waits another five minutes. Input clears on focus or connection loss. Shared time continues. Control stays active while the driving controls or map have focus. After renewals stop, it expires in five seconds; take control again to drive.
controllerReferenced: This controller is assigned to trains or groups. Reassign them before deleting it.
controllerCopyHelp: The copy has independent settings. Existing assignments keep using the original controller.
controllerSharedHelp: These location settings affect every train using this controller. Unconfigured harbors wait 10 minutes, then depart. Apply or cancel this location before editing another.
signalSharedController: Choose the shared controller whose settings you want to edit here. Each passing train uses its own effective controller.
controllerDelegationHelp: A train uses its group controller only when assigned “Use group controller”. Explicit train assignments stay in effect.
controllerConflict: This controller changed or was deleted. Cancel and reopen the draft.
controllerReferenceHelp: Assignments share one controller. Copy it to make independent settings.
controllerCleanJunctionsHelp: Apply removes the listed settings for locations where no junction remains. Stop settings are retained.
controllerJunctionHelp: Choose the default route at an existing junction. Unconfigured junctions go straight.
controllerHarborHelp: Settings use the harbor location: the signal itself, or the host station for a yard. Unconfigured stops wait 10 game minutes. Daily departures at the arrival time wait until the next day.
ruleClearHelp: Remove every rule at this location? Apply confirms this change.
ruleDuplicate: A rule with this exact mask already exists. Add requires a different mask; editing or copying a rule permits duplicates.
ruleHarborHelp: Rules run from top to bottom. Arrival checks Pass and Stop, otherwise waits 10 minutes. Later calls check departure actions or Stop, otherwise wait for the next ten-minute boundary. All specified mask fields must match.
ruleJunctionHelp: The first matching rule chooses the route. If none matches, use the default route. Minutes are always Any (*).
ruleTurningHelp: Turning reorders cars on supported straight track before departure. Other poses keep the source reversal behavior; a single diagonal car also enables forwarding.
ruleSaveSettingFirst: Apply the location setting before editing its rules.
groupHelp: Create nested groups and move trains or groups using these controls. Groups cannot be deleted. Choose “Use group controller” to inherit; an explicit assignment stays in effect.
groupMoveHelp: The train’s own controller assignment is retained. Delegated trains use the destination group’s controller.
groupConflict: This group or its membership changed. Cancel and reopen the draft.
